newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish bonds unchanged, struggle with resistance.
newsitem.headline: Irish bonds unchanged, struggle with resistance.

text.p: Irish government bonds were unchanged in thin late trade on Thursday as the market struggled to break through current resistence levels, dealers said.
"Irish bonds are looking a touch tired at their current levels, they seem to be reaching their resistance levels," one dealer said. "It is basically the same story in international markets."
By 1620 GMT the 6.5 percent bond due 2001 was unchanged from Wednesday's close at 101.75 to yield 5.99 percent while the eight percent bond due 2006 was unchanged at 108.85 to yield 6.61 percent.
Dealers said U.S. Treasuries and German bunds were also struggling to push higher and were mostly unchanged this afternoon.
